proofs.text: Retag `PROOF-1` as `@manual`, record the project and run the auto-approval; verify nothing is written

reasons: PROOF-19 happy_path_only: No proof of this rule names a rejection, an error or a boundary.
rule_text: CI never auto-approves a rule proved by a `@manual` proof, because that evidence is a person's note

tests.body:
def test_a_manual_proof_is_never_auto_approved(self):
        made = Project(spec=SPEC.replace(
            'verify 200 and a token @integration',
            'verify 200 and a token @manual'))
        try:
            made.proofs()
            made.record()
            assert approve_module.auto_approve(made.root) == [], (
                'the evidence for a manual proof is a person\'s note')
        finally:
            made.close()
tests.name: test_a_manual_proof_is_never_auto_approved
